name: Jiangyin Pivot Automotive Products Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 2009 and headquartered in Jiangyin, China, Jiangyin Pivot Automotive Products Co., Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing and supply of advanced connection technologies and comprehensive piping systems for the automotive industry across China. The company offers a diverse product portfolio, encompassing fluid transfer lines designed for water coolant, powertrain, and vacuum systems, alongside specialized pipeline solutions tailored for Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicles (PHEVs). Additionally, they provide a range of essential connecting and decorative components for vehicles.
